purpose: Public-claim gate for the v1.1 evidence corpus. Establishes which statements may be made publicly and which are explicitly not claimed. Supersedes the v1.0 public security claims decision (see supersession-map entry PUBLIC-SECURITY-CLAIMS-DECISION, state HISTORICAL_ONLY).

rules.subject: capability_status
rules.rule: Public pages and docs must only assert a capability status that matches the v1.1 manifest proof_status vocabulary (victory_locked, proven_sandbox, proven_staging, proven_production, implementation_present, planned, blocked, not_claimed).

rules.subject: forbidden_status
rules.rule: No assertion of certified, authorized, compliant, satisfied, or guaranteed status for any security, compliance, or regulatory property.

rules.subject: provider_packs
rules.rule: Antom/Alipay and WeChat Pay provider Packs are IN DEVELOPMENT; UnionPay is PLANNED. No generally-available or production claim for any provider Pack.

rules.subject: aws
rules.rule: No AWS program acceptance, provider partnership, mainland-China deployment, or provider logo claim is permitted.

rules.subject: payload_locality
rules.rule: Payload locality is an architectural commitment and must not be weakened with 'where possible' or 'best effort' qualifiers.

rules.subject: evidence_level
rules.rule: Evidence level claims must match the manifest evidence_level vocabulary (CODE_INSPECTION, UNIT_TEST, INTEGRATION_TEST, E2E_TEST, SANDBOX_CI, STAGING_VALIDATED, PRODUCTION_LIVE).

rules.subject: contact
rules.rule: Public contact must use the approved channel (mailto:zen@zen-mesh.io). No alternative contact surfaces.
